stem: Which equipment requirement applies to deep sedation or general anesthesia in addition to the equipment needed for moderate sedation?

options.text: No additional equipment is needed beyond what is used for moderate sedation.
A pediatric-capable ECG monitor and a defibrillator, both readily available.
A pediatric-capable ECG monitor only, with no defibrillator needed.
A defibrillator that is obtained from emergency services only after cardiac arrest occurs.
